title: Doctor Payload Schema
description: Output shape of `qdev doctor --json`. Each section is a flat object whose fields are section-specific; only `name` is common to all of them; `qdev doctor` reports the `cache` section first, then `validation`, and later epics add sections without changing this envelope. Section-specific fields are declared inside that section's own branch, so a new section is free to spell its fields however it needs — nothing here constrains a name this schema does not know. Schema changes follow semver on schema_version; additive fields do not bump the major.

status.description: "ok" only when the observed version matches and no table is missing.

cache_schema_version.description: The version the cache database actually carries, read from it rather than reported back from this binary's own constant.

expected_cache_schema_version.description: The version this binary was built for.

schema_status.description: "ok" only when the observed version matches and no table is missing.

missing_tables.description: Expected tables absent from the database.

entity_count.description: Null when the cache is too damaged to read, in which case schema_status explains why.

finding_count.description: The number of rows in the `findings` table, i.e. cache-native (hydration-recorded) findings only — the four computed checks are never written there, so 0 here is not a clean bill of health. See the validation section for the full count. Null when the cache is too damaged to read.

status.description: "unavailable" when the validation pass could not complete, in which case finding_count and findings_by_code are null.

unavailable_reason.description: The error code that prevented the pass from completing; null when status is "ok".

finding_count.description: The total number of findings `run_validation` computes — the same set `qdev validate` reports. Null when the pass could not complete.

findings_by_code.description: Per-finding-code counts, code-sorted; an empty object on a clean workspace, null when the pass could not complete.

status.description: "unavailable" when the leases diagnostic pass could not complete.

unavailable_reason.description: The error code that prevented the pass from completing; null when status is "ok".

active_count.description: The total number of active story leases discovered across local and shared git locations. Null when the pass could not complete.

stale_count.description: The number of active leases older than stale_age_days. Null when the pass could not complete.

stale_age_days.description: The configured threshold in days after which a lease is considered stale.

stale_leases.description: List of stale lease records older than stale_age_days.

status.description: "ok" when all expected hooks are installed and match expected content, "mismatch" when any is missing or outdated, "unavailable" if not a git repository.

unavailable_reason.description: The error code that prevented the hooks check from completing (e.g. "not_a_git_repository"); null when status is "ok" or "mismatch".

all_installed.description: True when all expected hook shims exist, are executable, and contain the expected hook invocation. Null when unavailable.

missing_hooks.description: Names of expected hooks that do not exist or are not executable. Null when unavailable.

outdated_hooks.description: Names of expected hooks whose content does not match expected shim content. Null when unavailable.

status.description: "ok" when all installed skills match the binary version or none are installed, "mismatch" when any installed skill's version stamp differs from the binary, "unavailable" if inspection failed.

unavailable_reason.description: The error code that prevented the skills check from completing; null when status is "ok" or "mismatch".

installed_count.description: Number of qdev skills/rules currently installed in the workspace.

outdated_count.description: Number of installed skills/rules whose version stamp differs from the binary version.

up_to_date.description: True when all installed skills match the binary version or none are installed.

outdated_skills.description: Relative paths to installed skills whose version stamp differs from the binary version.

status.description: "ok" when registered in at least one editor and handshake succeeds, "unregistered" when not registered in any editor, "unavailable" if inspection failed.

unavailable_reason.description: The error code that prevented MCP inspection from completing; null when status is "ok" or "unregistered".

registered.description: True when qdev MCP server is registered in .claude/settings.json or .cursor/mcp.json.

handshake_ok.description: True when the MCP server successfully completes the initialize handshake.

registered_targets.description: List of targets (e.g. "claude", "cursor") where qdev MCP server is registered.

status.description: "ok" when tree is clean and integration is normal, "mismatch" when dirty or diverged, "unavailable" outside a git repository.

unavailable_reason.description: The error code that prevented git inspection (e.g. "not_a_git_repository"); null when status is "ok" or "mismatch".

clean.description: True when git status --porcelain reports 0 dirty files. Null when unavailable.

dirty_files.description: Count of modified, staged, or untracked files. Null when unavailable.

branch.description: Current active git branch. Null when unavailable.

head.description: Current HEAD commit SHA. Null when unavailable.

integration_state.description: Integration sync state (e.g. "up_to_date", "behind", "ahead", "diverged"). Null when unavailable.

ahead.description: Commits ahead of integration branch. Null when unavailable or not count-based.

behind.description: Commits behind integration branch. Null when unavailable or not count-based.

status.description: "ok" when all path globs match at least one file, "mismatch" when any module glob matches 0 files, "unavailable" on failure.

unavailable_reason.description: Error code if modules check failed; null otherwise.

declared_count.description: Total number of modules declared in configuration.

unmatched_count.description: Number of declared path globs matching zero files.

unmatched_globs.description: Declared path globs matching zero files.

status.description: "ok" when all configured gate executables exist, "mismatch" when any executable is missing, "unavailable" on failure.

unavailable_reason.description: Error code if gates inspection failed; null otherwise.

configured_count.description: Total number of configured verification gates.

missing_count.description: Count of configured gates with missing executable binaries.

missing_executables.description: List of gate IDs or commands whose executable binary could not be found.

skipped_locally_count.description: Count of configured gates marked skip = true in local configuration.
